topic_definition: Stage 2 confirms the canonical source-faithful eligibility on full text. The paper must pertain to preference learning under the review's definition, be applied within the audio domain, and not be a survey/review article. Evaluation-only use of preferences is excluded.
decision_policy: Recommend include only when the full text supports an in-scope preference-learning path, supports audio-domain fit, and does not trigger any exclusion. Recommend exclude when preferences are evaluation-only, when the work is out of audio scope, or when the paper is a survey/review. Recommend maybe only for genuinely unresolved full-text edge cases.

criteria.criterion_text: Paper pertains to preference learning, defined as ranking or A/B comparison of two or more audio clips; numeric ratings count only when converted to rankings; preferences may be human or synthetic; papers without explicit comparisons are still eligible when they contain an RL training loop for an audio model.
criteria.criterion_question: Does the full text support an in-scope preference-learning path, including explicit comparisons, ratings converted to rankings, or an RL training loop for an audio model?
criteria.assessment_policy: Use NO when the full text does not support any eligible preference-learning path.

criteria.criterion_text: Paper is applied within the audio domain. Multimodal works including audio are treated as within the audio domain.
criteria.criterion_question: Does the full text support that the work is in the audio domain, including multimodal work that clearly includes audio?
criteria.assessment_policy: Use NO when the work is not actually applied to audio.

criteria.criterion_text: Paper is not a survey or review article.
criteria.criterion_question: Does the full text support that this is not a survey or review article?
criteria.assessment_policy: Use NO when the full text instead supports a survey or review.

criteria.criterion_text: Studies that use preferences solely for evaluation, with no learning component, are excluded.
criteria.criterion_question: Does the full text show that preferences are used only for evaluation and not for model learning or alignment?
criteria.assessment_policy: Use YES only for clear evaluation-only preference usage.

criteria.criterion_text: Survey or review articles are excluded.
criteria.criterion_question: Does the full text show that this is a survey or review article?
criteria.assessment_policy: Use YES only for explicit survey/review evidence.
